items.title: Tom Ford — Eau d'Ombre Leather
items.cap: A deeper scent found by following a review trail.
body: A review video made the notes sound interesting, so I tried it at Nordstrom without initially knowing where the bottle was displayed. The soft, floating quality caught me immediately. It also made me realize how consistently my taste leans toward deeper scents.

Where AI fits: it has not yet. This breakout is the structure for the experiment — gather sources, retain attribution, draft a personal post, and compare the draft with what I would naturally say before anything is published.

items.title: Bougatsa — Greek custard pie
items.cap: Part of learning the three primary custard styles deliberately.
body: I love desserts, but making them myself gives me more control over sugar and ingredients while teaching me the techniques behind them. Bougatsa is part of a larger goal: understand the three primary custard styles well enough to make them deliberately rather than simply follow instructions.
Recipes are also a way to share something with my family. I tried this again to maintain the slightly lighter filling, but did add a quick syrup similar to galaktoboureko to set it off more.
Galaktoboureko is King — next: a syrup variation closer to galaktoboureko, a small custard-learning series, and draft posts.
